text: {"lessons":["My account has moved up and down even when I made no trades, so I should not mistake monthly fluctuations for a need to act.","Selling Stock A and Stock D below my average cost did not by itself protect my account; I should decide based on each holding’s outlook and the risk it adds.","Selling Stock B after a gain was not automatically the right choice; I should trade only when it fits my retirement needs and overall plan."]}
